issues.detail: The Hebrew says 'Joshua said to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh' (יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אָמַר לֵאמֹר). The Vietnamese renders it as 'The LORD spoke to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh through Joshua' (Đức Giê-hô-va nói ... qua Giô-suê), which reverses the subject and object: it makes the LORD the speaker and Joshua the mediator, whereas the Hebrew has Joshua as the speaker addressing the tribes. This changes who is doing what to whom.
